steps.objective: Does perception stay coherent as source and observer cross simulation ownership boundaries? Use the retained source/receiver scene. Move the player's loading boundary while preserving the actual source and same observer, then compare fresh samples. Success boundary: Loading changes neither the physical visibility rule nor once-only ownership; source absence, old memory and actual new detection remain distinct.
proof_targets: fresh isolated profile, exact source-bound product and same saved world
initial actual source absolute position/class/fire/fuel and sole-source qualification
actual avatar absolute positions and game turns on both sides of predicted boundary and on reverse crossing
qualified normal map centering invariant and explicitly labeled geometric loaded-bound inference
actual signal/receiver records on each observed five-minute cadence, without treating absent rows as exact unload
actual fire/source state and source-discovery trace for the same absolute source on return, with real 900-turn phase and game time
survival and actor/world continuity; no support, observation, report or persistence replay
native save/exit and exact owned process/helper closure if operation reaches end

actual source age/field and lead last_seen/last_checked before crossing, outside, on inside-boundary re-discovery, and after physical return; distinguish legitimate loaded refresh from an unobserved offscreen interval
invariants: inherited fixture/save state earns zero gameplay credit
no injected or debug-created source, clue, actor, perception, report or time
no teleport, keyboard, mouse, inventory.details or raw save editing
single isolated signal source only; check competing same-class sources before attribution
do not infer unload solely from absent R008 packet; distinguish direct native receipt from geometry inference
bind every movement and source observation to actual returned turn/minute; never infer turns from distance
do not renew fire age or suppress starvation across out-of-bounds transitions
do not claim actor-specific scouting, return support or persistence in this focused run
do not claim continuous burning or exact source state while out of bounds; only assert what actual pre-crossing, post-reentry and source trace evidence supports
reverse to x3563 and wait there for the real source phase before physically returning to source tile

evidence_contract.claim: A single ordinary sustained source at a qualified absolute map tile can be followed through an ordinary loaded-map edge and back; actual movement/time and any source rediscovery are bound to native receipts. Loaded-bound transition uses explicitly labeled code-grounded geometric inference unless direct runtime evidence is available.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No actual positions/turns on both sides of the edge, loss/starvation or ambiguity of the source, competing-source ambiguity, no native return/discovery evidence, or unresolved process/build/profile binding leaves this focused behavior unproved.

starting_state.guidance: Use the declared coherent footing for this executable route. The standard house is the default adaptation for fire, camp and human interaction questions; it is not a substitute for a specific retained state or controlled diagnostic. Preserve owner originals.

playtest_recipe.exercise: Use the retained source/receiver scene. Move the player's loading boundary while preserving the actual source and same observer, then compare fresh samples.
controls: play look — identify the current input owner and relevant scene.
play controls — obtain current native actions and copyable movement/wait requests.
play act ACTION [--target STABLE_ID] — select an advertised action; use live IDs, not historical examples.
play wait 5m safe — example of a batched native wait, not a required interval. Choose duration and safe/stop/ignore for the actual question; ignore can allow injury or death.
For movement, use the advertised game.move_relative request through play call --request REQUEST.json, or native overmap travel for a usable route. Stop at a decision, obstruction or danger.
play collect — collect an outstanding request instead of submitting it again.
play inspect SELECTOR — retrieve the relevant field from the returned evidence handle.
playtest_recipe.batching: Batch to the next useful observation or decision, not to a prescribed command count. Read menu replies before choosing targets. Preserve pending request IDs; inspect partial progress and continue the same request when appropriate. Read-only observations do not advance game time.
playtest_recipe.success: Loading changes neither the physical visibility rule nor once-only ownership; source absence, old memory and actual new detection remain distinct.
playtest_recipe.failure: A reproducible contradiction under the stated opportunity is a finding. Preserve the first divergence and distinguish product behavior from setup, transport or stale-input faults. Do not force the expected outcome.
playtest_recipe.inconclusive: Missing source, observer, reachability, elapsed time or current input ownership leaves that part unproved. Repair incidental setup in the current run where possible; do not substitute an easier endpoint.
playtest_recipe.evidence: Use play controls evidence_logs and the actual returned selectors. Record selected source/build, run and actor/site IDs, game-time endpoints and the decisive native events. Correlate emission, receipt, decision and physical action when relevant; a log label or spoken success alone is insufficient.
playtest_recipe.finish: Save useful unfinished state through the native save action. When the run is settled, close its game/helpers, verify exit and delete generated saves/logs/captures and temporary declarations. Keep owner originals and concise current findings; no archive.
playtest_recipe.reuse: Update this recipe with proven setup, controls and diagnostic queries that change future decisions. Replace obsolete advice. Keep live IDs and one-run chronology out; prior success is scoped evidence, not a current-build guarantee.
